description: Index of the DAOs on Caper: cashtag, name, description, member count, wiki URL, and that DAO's own MCP endpoint. Use it to resolve a name to a cashtag, then POST JSON-RPC to the returned `mcpEndpoint` to reach its get_ledger (treasury balances, proposal/trade/execution timeline, executed grants, inter-DAO funding) – this knowledge-base server deliberately has no ledger tool. `query` is a case-insensitive substring over cashtag, name and description. Defaults: limit 50 (max 200); `hasMore` says whether the cap cut the list.

query.description: Filter by cashtag, name or description (case-insensitive substring). Omit for all.

name: list_daos
title: List capers
